pending_qa.q: What was the significance of the GTA 6 gameplay reveal on Netflix and when is the game releasing?
pending_qa.r: Netflix dropped a 27-minute special on August 28, 2025, made entirely from PS5 footage showing real GTA 6 gameplay, crashing the platform and causing a spike in error reports on Down Detector. Netflix received a six-hour exclusive window before Rockstar could post the footage on YouTube. GTA 6 is set for release on November 19th, and a separate 30-minute press preview was held earlier that summer in Edinburgh, Scotland.

pending_qa.q: Why has Jackson Hole, Wyoming historically been the location of the Federal Reserve's annual symposium?
pending_qa.r: The tradition dates to the early 1980s, when the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City wanted to host its annual meeting and attract Fed Chair Paul Volcker as keynote speaker. Knowing Volcker loved fly fishing, they chose Jackson Hole, Wyoming, near the Tetons, as the venue. The event proved successful and became a permanent fixture on the Fed calendar.
